name: io.github.chelslava/md-semantic-search
description: Local, private semantic (vector) search over any folder of Markdown files. Finds passages by meaning — cross-lingual — hybrid dense+BM25F ranking, HNSW/IVF ANN, citation-first RAG, and an MCP server with 8 tools, resources, prompts, and client-side sampling. No API keys, no cloud, no vector database.

remotes.description: Opt-in Streamable HTTP transport mounted by `mdss serve --db <dir> --mcp` — loopback-only by default, behind the same auth/Host-allowlist/rate-limit gates as /search (issues #123, #119, #120).
